acquisition method: Data was acquired using a data-dependent “top 10” method
alkylation reagent: cell pellets were lysed with lysis buffer containing 0.25% sodium deoxycholate, 0.2 mM iodoacetamide, 1 mM EDTA
alkylation concentration: cell pellets were lysed with lysis buffer containing 0.25% sodium deoxycholate, 0.2 mM iodoacetamide, 1 mM EDTA
collision energy: Normalized collision energy was set to 25%
enrichment method: HLA-I molecules were immunoaffinity purified from cleared lysate with the pan-HLA-I antibody (W6/32 antibody purified from HB95 hybridoma cells) covalently bound to Protein-A Sepharose beads
fragmentation method: fragmenting the peptides by higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD)
instrument: which was coupled by electrospray to tandem mass spectrometry on Q-Exactive-Plus (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
ionization type: which was coupled by electrospray to tandem mass spectrometry on Q-Exactive-Plus (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
labeling: searched the peptides that exhibited a change in their intensity between groups
